thread:
Nina_Sales: Handing off Medidata (clinical trials customer). Contract signed today. Quick bullets:
- Private deployment in EU region, managed private control plane.
- Needs FHIR + CSV ingest, SSO via SAML, KMS + audit logs 7yrs.
- Pilot: 100 QPS steady, burst to 350 QPS. 6-week pilot window.
- Renewal sensitivity: high if pilot misses timelines.

Carl_CSM: Thanks Nina. Welcome team. Primary contact: joanne.liu@medidata.com (Onboarding Lead). Please attach SOW & DPA.

Nina_Sales: SOW link: https://drive.redwood/medidata/sow_final.pdf  DPA attached in drive. Joanne confirmed SAML IdP details will be provided.

Ravi_Support: I'll own VPC peering + firewall. Do we use private control plane endpoints over peering or a VPN? Need to know for runbook.

Nina_Sales: They prefer peering. Managed control plane in their VPC.

Maya_Eng: For FHIR ingestion I need a sample bundle and auth (SAML->OAuth exchange?). Also CSV sizes and frequency. For capacity planning, I'll draft recommendations (ETA 4 business days).

Carl_CSM: Next steps: 1) kickoff call (I'll schedule) 2) collect IdP metadata & SAML cert (Joanne + Carl) 3) Ravi to produce peering/runbook (48h) 4) Maya eng draft connector + capacity plan (4bd).

Ravi_Support: Creating support ticket SUP-9001 and uploading initial peering checklist. Link: https://support.redwood/t/SUP-9001

Cal_Bot: Calendar event created: "Medidata Onboarding Kickoff" Tue 11:00 AM CET. Invites: Nina_Sales, Carl_CSM, Ravi_Support, Maya_Eng, joanne.liu@medidata.com

Carl_CSM: I'll capture pilot success metrics in the tracker: ingestion 95p latency, error rate <1%, time-to-first-query <3min. If any blocker >48h I'll escalate to Ops lead.

Nina_Sales: Flagging risk: onboarding delays impact renewal discussions. I'll stay available for exec escalations.

Maya_Eng: Noted. I'll post ENG ticket with draft and request sample FHIR bundle ASAP. If Medidata can provide redacted data today, I can spin a 1-day parser spike this week.

Carl_CSM: Thanks everyone. I'll post kickoff invite and onboarding tracker link after scheduling. Ping here for reassignment or urgent blockers.
